G1342.def:
**δίκαιος**, -α, -ον
(δίκη), [in LXX chiefly for צַדִּיק (for rendering of צַדִּיק in sense of correct, see Deiss., BS, 115 f.); sometimes for נָקִי as [[Pro.1.11|Pro.1:11]], al. ;]
in early Gk. writers
(a) of persons, observant of δίκη, custom, rule, right, **righteous** in performing duties to gods and men ;
(b) of things, **righteous**, in accordance with right.
In NT
1. **righteous**, chiefly in the broad sense, as above, of the person or thing corresponding to the Divine standard of right
(a) **of persons**: of God, [[Rom.3.26|Rom.3:26]], [[1Jn.2.29|1Jn.2:29]] [[Jhn.3.7|Jn 3:7]]; of Christ, [[Act.3.14; 7.52; 22.14|Act.3:14 7:52 22:14]], [[1Pe.3.18|1Pe.3:18]], [[1Jn.2.1|1Jn.2:1]]; of men, [[Mat.1.19|Mat.1:19]] (Abbott, _Essays_, 75 f.) [[Mat.10.41; 13.17, 43; 13.49|Mat.10:41 13:17, 43 13:49]], [[Luk.1.6, 17|Luk.1:6, 17]], [[Rom.5.7|Rom.5:7]], [[1Ti.1.9|1Ti.1:9]], [[Jas.5.6|Jas.5:6]], [[1Pe.3.12|1Pe.3:12]], [[1Jn.3.7|1Jn.3:7]], [[Rev.22.11|Rev.22:11]], al.; δ. καὶ εὐλαβής, [[Luk.2.25|Luk.2:25]] ἅγιος, [[Mrk.6.20|Mrk.6:20]] ἀγαθός, [[Luk.23.50|Luk.23:50]] φοβούμενος τ. θεόν, [[Act.10.22|Act.10:22]] opposite to ἀμαρτωλοὶ καὶ ἀσεβεῖς, [[1Pe.4.18|1Pe.4:18]] ἄδικοι, [[Mat.5.45|Mat.5:45]], [[Act.24.15|Act.24:15]]; δ. ἐκ πίστεως, [[Rom.1.17|Rom.1:17]], [[Gal.3.11|Gal.3:11]], [[Heb.10.38|Heb.10:38]]" (LXX) ; δ. παρὰ τ. θεῷ, [[Rom.2.13|Rom.2:13]]
(b) **of things**: ἔργα δ., opposite to πονηρὰ, [[1Jn.3.12|1Jn.3:12]] ἐντολή, [[Rom.7.12|Rom.7:12]] metaphorically, αἷμα, [[Mat.23.35|Mat.23:35]] τὸ δ., [[Luk.12.57|Luk.12:57]] δ. ἐστιν, [[Act.4.19|Act.4:19]], [[Eph.6.1|Eph.6:1]], [[Php.1.7|Php.1:7]]; ὅ, [[Mat.20.4|Mat.20:4]] ὅσα, [[Php.4.8|Php.4:8]]
2. In narrower sense
(a) of persons, as in later cl. writers, **just**, **rendering to each his due**: [[Tit.1.8|Tit.1:8]], [[1Jn.1.9|1Jn.1:9]]; δ. κριτής, [[2Ti.4.8|2Ti.4:8]]
(b) **of things**: τὸ δ., [[Col.4.1|Col.4:1]] δ., sc. ἐστιν, [[2Th.1.6|2Th.1:6]] κρίσις δ., [[Jhn.5.30|Jhn.5:30]] ὁδοί, [[Rev.15.3|Rev.15:3]]
_SYN._: ἀγαθός (which see), καλός, χρηστός (Cremer, 183, 690). (AS)

G1332.def:
**διετής**, -ές
(δίς, ἔτος), [in LXX: [[2Ma.10.3|2Ma.10:3]] * ;]
1. **lasting two years**.
2. **two years old**: ἀπὸ δ. (sc. παιδός, or neuter; cf. [[1Ch.27.23|1Ch.27:23]], ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς), [[Mat.2.16|Mat.2:16]]†
(AS)

G1380.def:
**δοκέω**, -ῶ
(δόκος, opinion, δέκομαι, Ion, form of δέχ-), [in LXX for טוֹב, נָדַב, etc. ;]
1. **to be of opinion, suppose**: [[Mat.24.44|Mat.24:44]], [[Luk.12.40|Luk.12:40]], [[Heb.10.29|Heb.10:29]]; with inf., [[Mat.3.9|Mat.3:9]], [[Luk.8.18; 24.37|Luk.8:18 24:37]], [[Jhn.5.39; 16.2|Jhn.5:39 16:2]], [[Act.12.9; 27.13|Act.12:9 27:13]], [[1Co.3.18; 7.40; 8.2; 10.12; 14.37|1Co.3:18 7:40 8:2 10:12 14:37]], [[Gal.6.3|Gal.6:3]], [[Php.3.4|Php.3:4]], [[Jas.1.26|Jas.1:26]]; with accusative and inf., [[1Co.12.23|1Co.12:23]], [[2Co.11.16|2Co.11:16]]; before ὅτι, [[Mat.6.7; 26.53|Mat.6:7 26:53]], [[Mrk.6.49|Mrk.6:49]], [[Luk.12.51; 13.2, 4; 19.11|Luk.12:51 13:2, 4 19:11]], [[Jhn.5.45; 11.13, 31; 13.29; 20.15|Jhn.5:45 11:13, 31 13:29 20:15]], [[1Co.4.9|1Co.4:9]], [[2Co.12.19|2Co.12:19]], [[Jas.4.5|Jas.4:5]].
2. **to seem, be reputed**: [[Act.25.27|Act.25:27]] with inf., [[Mrk.10.42|Mrk.10:42]], [[Luk.10.36; 22.24|Luk.10:36 22:24]], [[Act.17.13; 26.9|Act.17:13 26:9]], [[1Co.11.16; 12.22|1Co.11:16 12:22]], [[2Co.10.9|2Co.10:9]], [[Gal.2.6|Gal.2:6]], 9, [[Heb.4.1; 12.11|Heb.4:1 12:11]]; οἱ δοκοῦντες, _those of repute_, [[Gal.2.2|Gal.2:2]] Impers., it seems, with dative of person(s);
(a) **to think**: [[Mat.17.25; 18.12; 21.28; 22.17, 42; 26.66|Mat.17:25 18:12 21:28 22:17, 42 26:66]], [[Jhn.11.56|Jhn.11:56]], [[Heb.12.10|Heb.12:10]];
(b) **to please, seem good to**: with inf., [[Luk.1.3|Luk.1:3]], [[Act.15.22, 25; 15.23, 34|Act.15:22, 25 15:23, 34]].†
_SYN._ (δοκέω 1): ἡγέομαι 2, νομίζω2, οἴομαι; ἡ. and ν. properly express belief resting on external proof, ἡ. denoting the more careful judgment; δ. and οἴ. imply a subjective judgment which in the case of οἴ. is based on feeling, in δ. on thought (see Schmidt, with 17) (δοκέω2): φαίνομαι; φ., from the standpoint of the object, "expresses how a matter phenomenally shows and presents itself"; δ., from the standpoint of the observer, expresses one's subjective judgment about a matter (see Tr., _Syn._, LXXx; Cremer, 204). (AS)

G1343.def:
**δικαιοσύνη**, -ης, ἡ
(δίκαιος), [in LXX chiefly for צֶדֶק, and cognates, [[Gen.15.6|Gen.15:6]], al., rarely for חֶסֶד, [[Gen.19.19|Gen.19:19]] ;]
the character of ὁ δίκαιος (which see)
1. in broad sense, **righteousness**, **conformity to the Divine will in purpose, thought and action**: [[Mat.5.6|Mat.5:6]], [[Jhn.16.8|Jhn.16:8]], [[Act.13.10|Act.13:10]], [[Rom.4.3|Rom.4:3]]; λόγος δικαιοσύνης, teaching of r., [[Heb.5.13|Heb.5:13]] βασιλεὺς δ. (cf. FlJ, BJ, vi, 10, β. δίκαιος), [[Heb.7.2|Heb.7:2]] ὅπλα δ., [[Rom.6.13|Rom.6:13]] ὁδὸς δ., [[Mat.21.32|Mat.21:32]] θώραξ τῆς δ., [[Eph.6.14|Eph.6:14]] διὰκονοι δ., [[2Co.11.15|2Co.11:15]] ὁσιότης καὶ δ., [[Luk.1.75|Luk.1:75]], cf. [[Eph.4.24|Eph.4:24]] ἀγαθωσύνῃ καὶ δ., [[Eph.5.9|Eph.5:9]] δ. κ. εἰρήνη κ. χαρά, [[Rom.14.17|Rom.14:17]] δ. κ. ἁγιασμός, [[1Co.1.30|1Co.1:30]] opposite to ἁμαρτία, [[Rom.8.10|Rom.8:10]] ἀνομία, [[2Co.6.14|2Co.6:14]] άδικία, [[Rom.3.5|Rom.3:5]] ποιεῖν τὴν δ., [[1Jn.2.29|1Jn.2:29]] [[Jhn.3.7|Jn 3:7]]; id. as an inclusive term for the active duties of the religious life (_ICC_, in l; Abbott, _Essays_, 73 ff), [[Mat.6.1|Mat.6:1]] ἐργάζεσθαι δ., [[Act.10.35|Act.10:35]] διώκειν δ., [[1Ti.6.11|1Ti.6:11]] πληροῦν πᾶσαν δ., [[Mat.3.15|Mat.3:15]] ζῆν τῇ δ., [[1Pe.2.24|1Pe.2:24]] δ. θεοῦ, a righteousness divine in its character and origin, [[Mat.6.33|Mat.6:33]], [[Jas.1.20|Jas.1:20]], (where it also includes the idea of God's personal r.; see _ICC_, on [[Rom.1.17|Rom.1:17]]) [[Rom.1.17; 3.5, 21-26; 10.3|Rom.1:17 3:5, 21-26 10:3]], [[2Co.5.21|2Co.5:21]], [[Php.3.9|Php.3:9]]; ἡ δ. τ. πίσιεως, [[Rom.4.11|Rom.4:11]] ἡ ἐκ π. δ., [[Rom.9.30|Rom.9:30]] ἡ κατὰ π. δ., [[Heb.11.7|Heb.11:7]] opposite to this is ἡ ἐκ νόμου δ., [[Rom.10.5|Rom.10:5]] ἡ δ. ἐν ν., [[Php.3.6|Php.3:6]] ἡ ἰδία δ., [[Rom.10.3|Rom.10:3]], cf. [[Php.3.9|Php.3:9]]
2. In narrower sense (cf. δίκαιος), **justice**: [[Act.17.31|Act.17:31]], [[2Pe.1.1|2Pe.1:1]], [[Rev.19.11|Rev.19:11]] (_DCG_, ii, 529 ff.; Cremer, 190, 690).
(AS)

G1391.def:
**δόξα**, -ης, ἡ
(δοκέω), [in LXX very frequently for כָּבוֹד, also for הוֹד ,פִּפְאֶרֶת, etc., 25 words in all ;]
in cl.,
1. **expectation, judgment, opinion** ([[4Ma.5.18|4Ma.5:18]]).
2. **opinion, estimation** in which one is held, **repute**; in NT, always **good opinion**, hence **reputation, praise, honour, glory**: [[Luk.14.10|Luk.14:10]], [[Jhn.12.43|Jhn.12:43]], [[Heb.3.3|Heb.3:3]]; opposite to αἰσχύνη, [[Php.3.19|Php.3:19]] to ἀτιμία, [[2Co.6.8|2Co.6:8]] δ. κ. τιμή, [[Rom.2.7, 10|Rom.2:7, 10]] [[1Pe.1.7|1Pe.1:7]], [[2Pe.1.17|2Pe.1:17]]; ζητεῖν, [[Jhn.5.44; 7.18; 8.50|Jhn.5:44 7:18 8:50]], [[1Th.2.6|1Th.2:6]]; λαμβάνειν, [[Jhn.5.41|Jhn.5:41]], [[2Pe.1.17|2Pe.1:17]], [[Rev.5.12|Rev.5:12]]; διδόναι δ. τ. θεῷ (cf. נָתַן כָּבוֹד לַיהוָֹה, [[Jer.13.16|Jer.13:16]], al.), [[Luk.17.18|Luk.17:18]], [[Jhn.9.24|Jhn.9:24]], [[Act.12.23|Act.12:23]], [[Rom.4.20|Rom.4:20]], [[Rev.4.9|Rev.4:9]]; εἰς (τ.) δ. θεοῦ, [[Rom.3.7; 15.7|Rom.3:7 15:7]], [[Php.1.11|Php.1:11]], al.; in doxologies, τ. θεῷ (ᾧ) ἡ δ., [[Luk.2.14|Luk.2:14]], [[Rom.11.36; 16.27|Rom.11:36 16:27]], [[Gal.1.5|Gal.1:5]], [[Eph.3.21|Eph.3:21]], al.
3. Later also (not cl.) as in LXX (= הוֹד, [[Job.39.20|Job.39:20]], [[1Ch.29.25|1Ch.29:25]]; כָּבוֹד, [[Job.19.9|Job.19:9]], [[Est.5.11|Est.5:11]], al.), visible **brightness, splendour, glory**: of light, [[Act.22.11|Act.22:11]] of heavenly bodies, [[1Co.15.40|1Co.15:40]]ff.; esp. that wh. radiates from God's presence, as manifested in the pillar of cloud and in the Holy of Holies (= כָּבוֹד, [[Exo.16.10; 25.22; 40.34|Exo.16:10 25:22 40:34]], al.; and new Heb. שְׁכִינָה, [[2Ma.2.8|2Ma.2:8]] see _DB_, iv, 489b), [[Rom.9.4|Rom.9:4]], [[Jas.2.1|Jas.2:1]] (see Hort, Mayor, in l.); hence of the manifested glory of God, [[Rom.1.23|Rom.1:23]], [[Col.1.11|Col.1:11]] [[Eph.1.6, 12, 17; 3.16|Eph.1:6, 12 17 3:16]]; of the same as communicated to man through Christ, [[2Co.3.18; 4.6|2Co.3:18 4:6]]; and of the glorious condition into which Christians shall enter hereafter, [[Rom.8.18, 21; 9.23|Rom.8:18, 21 9:23]], [[2Ti.2.10|2Ti.2:10]], al.
_SYN._: ἔπαινος τιμή (see Hort on [[1Pe.1.7|1Pe.1:7]]). (AS)

G1325.def:
**δίδωμι**,
[in LXX chiefly for נָתַן (53 words in all) ;]
**to give**—in various senses, accusative to context—**bestow, grant, supply, deliver, commit, yield**: absol., [[Act.20.35|Act.20:35]] with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[Mat.4.9; 5.31|Mat.4:9 5:31]], [[Jhn.1.12|Jhn.1:12]], al. mult.; with dative of person(s), before ἐκ, [[Mat.25.8|Mat.25:8]] id. with genitive part.. [[Rev.2.17|Rev.2:17]] with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.3.16|Jhn.3:16]], [[Rev.20.13|Rev.20:13]], al.; δεξιάς, [[Gal.2.9|Gal.2:9]] φίλημα, [[Luk.7.45|Luk.7:45]] γνῶσιν, [[Luk.1.77|Luk.1:77]] κρίσιν, [[Jhn.5.22|Jhn.5:22]] of seed yielding fruit, [[Mrk.4.7|Mrk.4:7]], 8; ἐργασίαν (Deiss., _LAE_, 117f.), [[Luk.12.58|Luk.12:58]] with inf. fin., [[Mat.27.34|Mat.27:34]], [[Mrk.5.43|Mrk.5:43]], [[Luk.8.55|Luk.8:55]], [[Jhn.6.52|Jhn.6:52]], al.; with dative of person(s) and inf., [[Luk.1.74|Luk.1:74]], al.; with accusative and inf., [[Act.2.27|Act.2:27]], [[Rev.3.9|Rev.3:9]]; with dupl. accusative, [[Mat.20.28|Mat.20:28]], [[Mrk.10.45|Mrk.10:45]], [[Eph.1.22; 4.11|Eph.1:22 4:11]], [[2Th.3.9|2Th.3:9]], [[1Ti.2.6|1Ti.2:6]], al.; ἑαυτὸν δ. εἰς (Polyb., al.), [[Act.19.31|Act.19:31]] with dative of person(s), before κατά (MM, _Exp._, xi), [[Rev.2.28|Rev.2:28]] (LXX); δ. ἵνα, [[Rev.3.9|Rev.3:9]] δέδωκα ἐνώπιόν σου θύραν ἀνεῳγμένην, [[Rev.3.8|Rev.3:8]]
_SYN._: δωρέομαι. (AS)

G1350.def:
**δίκτυον**, -ον, τό
[in LXX chiefly for רֶשֶׁת, שְׂבָכָה ;]
general term for a **net**: [[Mat.4.20-21|Mat.4:20-21]], [[Mrk.1.18-19|Mrk.1:18-19]], [[Luk.5.2, 4-6|Luk.5:2, 4-6]], [[Jhn.21.6, 8; 21.11|Jhn.21:6, 8 21:11]] †
_SYN._: ἀμφίβληστρον (which see), σαγήνη. (AS)

G1321.def:
**διδάσκω**
[in LXX chiefly for למד pl., also for ידע hi., ירה hi., etc. ;]
**to teach** (i.e. **instruct**) a person, **teach** a thing;
1. trans.: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.5.2|Mat.5:2]], [[Mrk.1.22|Mrk.1:22]], al.; before ὅτι, [[Mrk.8.31|Mrk.8:31]] περί, [[1Jn.2.27|1Jn.2:27]] with inf., [[Luk.11.1|Luk.11:1]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mrk.6.30; 12.14|Mrk.6:30 12:14]]; with cogn. accusative, [[Mat.15.9|Mat.15:9]] (LXX); with dupl. accusative, [[Mrk.4.2|Mrk.4:2]], [[Jhn.14.26|Jhn.14:26]]; pass., [[Gal.1.12|Gal.1:12]], [[2Th.2.15|2Th.2:15]]; with dative of person(s) (like Heb., cf. [[Job.21.23|Job.21:23]], but prob. a vernac. usage, see Swete, in l.), [[Rev.2.14|Rev.2:14]]
2. Absol., **to teach, give instruction**: [[Mat.4.23|Mat.4:23]], [[Mrk.1.21|Mrk.1:21]], and often in Gosp., [[Rom.12.7|Rom.12:7]], [[1Co.4.17|1Co.4:17]], [[1Ti.2.12|1Ti.2:12]], al.
_SYN._: παιδεύω (cf. Westc., _Heb._, 402; Cremer, 180). (AS)

G1392.def:
**δοξάζω**
(δόξα), [in LXX chiefly for כָּבַד ni., pi., also for פָּאַר, etc. ;]
1. to think, suppose, hold an opinion (Æsch., Plat., al.).
2. To bestow δόξα (which see) on, **to magnify, extol, praise **(Thuc., iii, 45; Plut., al.): with accusative, [[Mat.5.16|Mat.5:16]], [[Mrk.2.12|Mrk.2:12]], [[Jhn.8.54|Jhn.8:54]], [[Rom.15.6|Rom.15:6]], [[1Pe.2.12|1Pe.2:12]], al.; id. before ἐπί [[Luk.2.20|Luk.2:20]] ἐν, [[Gal.1.24|Gal.1:24]], [[1Pe.4.16|1Pe.4:16]].
3. In LXX and NT (see: δόξα, 3), to clothe with splendour, glorify ([[Exo.34.29-30|Exo.34:29-30]], [[Psa.37.20|Psa.37:20]], [[Isa.44.23|Isa.44:23]], [[Est.3.1|Est.3:1]], al): [[Rom.8.30|Rom.8:30]], [[2Co.3.10|2Co.3:10]], [[2Th.3.1|2Th.3:1]], [[1Pe.1.8|1Pe.1:8]], al.; of Christ, [[Jhn.7.39; 8.54|Jhn.7:39 8:54]], al. (on the Johannine use, see Cremer, 211; Westc., Jo., _Intr._); of the Father, [[Jhn.13.31-32|Jhn.13:31-32]], [[1Pe.4.11|1Pe.4:11]], al. (cf. ἐν-, συν-δοξάζω).
(AS)

G1358.def:
**δι-ορύσσω **
[in LXX: [[Job.24.16|Job.24:16]], [[Exo.12.5, 7; 12.12|Exo.12:5, 7 12:12]], (חָתַר) * ;]
**to dig through**: with accusative, of house-breaking (as in π.; MM, _Exp._, xi), [[Mat.24.43|Mat.24:43]], [[Luk.12.39|Luk.12:39]]; absol., [[Mat.6.19-20|Mat.6:19-20]]†
(AS)

G1398.def:
**δουλεύω**
(δοῦλος), [in LXX for עָבַד, as [[Gen.14.4|Gen.14:4]], exc. Da TH [[Dan.7.14, 27|Dan.7:14, 27]] (פְּלַח), [[Isa.56.6|Isa.56:6]] (שָׁרַת pi.)* ;]
**to be a slave, be subject to, serve**: absol., [[Rom.7.6|Rom.7:6]], [[Gal.4.25|Gal.4:25]], [[1Ti.6.2|1Ti.6:2]]; with dative of person(s), [[Mat.6.24|Mat.6:24]], [[Luk.15.29; 16.13|Luk.15:29 16:13]], [[Rom.9.12|Rom.9:12]]" (LXX) ; of nations, [[Jhn.8.33|Jhn.8:33]], [[Act.7.7|Act.7:7]]" (LXX) ; θεῷ, τ. κυρίῳ, [[Mat.6.24|Mat.6:24]], [[Luk.16.13|Luk.16:13]], [[Act.20.19|Act.20:19]], [[Rom.12.11|Rom.12:11]] (R, mg., καιρῷ) [[Rom.16.18|Rom.16:18]], [[Eph.6.7|Eph.6:7]], [[Col.3.24|Col.3:24]], [[1Th.1.9|1Th.1:9]]; τ. Χριστῷ, [[Rom.14.18|Rom.14:18]], [[Col.3.24|Col.3:24]]; νόμῳ θεοῦ, [[Rom.7.25|Rom.7:25]] τ. θεοῖς, [[Gal.4.8|Gal.4:8]] τ. καιρῷ, [[Rom.12.11|Rom.12:11]] (R, mg. for κυρίῳ); ἀλλήλοις, [[Gal.5.13|Gal.5:13]] σὺν ἐμοί [[Php.2.22|Php.2:22]] τ. ἁμαρτίᾳ, [[Rom.6.6|Rom.6:6]] νόμῳ ἁμαρτίας, [[Rom.7.25|Rom.7:25]]
ἐπιθυμίαις κ. ἡδοναις, [[Tit.3.3|Tit.3:3]] τ. κοιλία, [[Rom.16.18|Rom.16:18]] μαμωνᾷ, [[Mat.6.24|Mat.6:24]], [[Luk.16.13|Luk.16:13]]; τ. στοιχείοις τ, κόσμου, [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]] (Cremer, 217).†
(AS)

G1308.def:
**δια-φέρω **
[in LXX for שְׁנָא (שְׁנָא ([[Dan.7.1-28|Dan.7:1-28]] only); [[1Ki.17.39|1Ki.17:39]], [[Est.3.13|Est.3:13]], al. ;]
1. trans.,
(a) **to carry through**: before διά, [[Mrk.11.16|Mrk.11:16]]
(b) **to carry about, spread abroad**: pass., [[Act.13.49; 27.27|Act.13:49 27:27]].
2. Intrans.,
(a) **to differ**: τὰ διαφέροντα, [[Rom.2.18|Rom.2:18]], [[Php.1.10|Php.1:10]] (R, mg., but see infr.); impers., διαφέρει, **it makes a difference, it matters**: [[Gal.2.6|Gal.2:6]]
(b) **to excel**: with genitive [[Mat.6.26; 10.31; 12.12|Mat.6:26 10:31 12:12]], [[Luk.12.7, 24|Luk.12:7, 24]], [[1Co.15.41|1Co.15:41]], [[Gal.4.1|Gal.4:1]]; τὰ διαφέροντα, [[Rom.2.18|Rom.2:18]], [[Php.1.10|Php.1:10]] (R, txt.; for discussion and reff. see _ICC_ on Ro, Phi, ll. with).†
(AS)

G1385.def:
**δοκός**, -οῦ, ἡ
(δέχομαι) [in LXX for קוֹרָה, etc. ;]
**a beam of timber**: [[Mat.7.3-5|Mat.7:3-5]], [[Luk.6.41-42|Luk.6:41-42]] (_DCG_, i, 176).†
(AS)

G1390.def:
**δόμα**, -τος, τό
(δίδωμι), [in LXX for מַתָּנָה, etc. ;]
**a gift**: [[Mat.7.11|Mat.7:11]], [[Luk.11.13|Luk.11:13]], [[Eph.4.8|Eph.4:8]]" (LXX), [[Php.4.17|Php.4:17]]†
_SYN._: δόσις, δῶρον, δωρεά, δώρημα (AS)

G1320.def:
**διδάσκαλος**, -ου, ὁ
(διδάσκω), [in LXX: [[Est.6.1|Est.6:1]], [[2Ma.1.10|2Ma.1:10]] * ;]
given as rendering of Heb. רַבִּי ,רַבּוֺן (NT, Ῥαββεί, Ῥαββουνεί which see);
**a teacher**: [[Jhn.1.39; 20.16|Jhn.1:39 20:16]]; of Jewish teachers, [[Luk.2.46|Luk.2:46]], [[Jhn.3.10|Jhn.3:10]], cf. [[Rom.2.20-21;|Rom.2:20-21]] of John Baptist, [[Luk.3.12|Luk.3:12]] of Jesus, [[Jhn.3.2, 10; 8.4; 11.28; 13.13-14|Jhn.3:2, 10 8:4 11:28 13:13-14]], and often in _Syn._, most frequently in voc., as title of address, as [[Mat.8.19|Mat.8:19]], [[Mrk.4.38|Mrk.4:38]]; of Jesus by himself, [[Mat.23.8|Mat.23:8]] of an apostle, [[1Ti.2.7|1Ti.2:7]], [[2Ti.1.11|2Ti.1:11]]; of Christians, [[1Co.12.28-29|1Co.12:28-29]], [[Eph.4.11|Eph.4:11]], [[Act.13.1|Act.13:1]], [[Jas.3.1|Jas.3:1]]; of false teachers, [[2Ti.4.3|2Ti.4:3]] (Cremer, 181; _DB_, i, 609, iii, 294, iv, 691)
_SYN._: παιδευτής, q.v (AS)

G1310.def:
**δια-φημίζω **
in late writers only, **to spread abroad**: τ. λόγον (= דָּבָר, _the matter_), [[Mrk.1.45|Mrk.1:45]], [[Mat.28.15|Mat.28:15]]; with accusative of person(s), **to spread abroad one's fame**: [[Mat.9.31|Mat.9:31]]†
(AS)

G1369.def:
**διχάζω**
(δίχα, apart), [in Aq.: [[Lev.1.17|Lev.1:17]], [[Deu.14.6|Deu.14:6]] * ;]
**to cut apart, divide in two**; metaphorically, **to set at variance**: [[Mat.10.35|Mat.10:35]]†
(AS)

G1344.def:
**δικαιόω**, -ῶ
(δίκαιος), [in LXX chiefly for צָדַק pi., hi., (1) as [[Ezk.16.51|Eze.16:51]], [[Jer.3.11|Jer.3:11]] (cf. NT usage); (2) as [[Deu.25.1|Deu.25:1]] [[Exo.23.7|Exo.23:7]], [[Isa.50.8|Isa.50:8]] ;]
1. in cl.,
(a) with accusative of thing(s), **to deem right**;
(b) with accusative of person(s), **to do one justice**; pass., δικαιοῦσθαι, **to be treated rightly**, opposite to ἀδικεῖσθαι.
2. In NT, as in LXX, and as usual with verbs in -όω from adjectives of moral meaning;
(1) **to show to be righteous**: [[Mat.11.19|Mat.11:19]], [[Luk.7.35|Luk.7:35]], [[Rom.3.4|Rom.3:4]]" (LXX), [[1Ti.3.16|1Ti.3:16]]
(2) **to declare, pronounce righteous**: [[Luk.7.29; 10.29; 16.15; 18.14|Luk.7:29 10:29 16:15 18:14]], [[Rom.2.13; 3.24, 26; 3.28; 4.5; 8.30, 33|Rom.2:13 3:24, 26 3:28 4:5 8:30, 33]], [[Tit.3.7|Tit.3:7]]; before ἀπό, [[Mat.11.19|Mat.11:19]], [[Luk.7.35|Luk.7:35]], [[Act.13.39|Act.13:39]], [[Rom.6.7|Rom.6:7]]; ἐκ πίστεως, [[Rom.3.30; 5.1|Rom.3:30 5:1]], [[Gal.2.16; 3.8, 24|Gal.2:16 3:8, 24]]; ἐξ ἔργων, [[Rom.3.20|Rom.3:20]] (LXX) [[Rom.4.2|Rom.4:2]], [[Gal.2.16|Gal.2:16]], [[Jas.2.21, 24-25|Jas.2:21, 24-25]]; ἐκ τ. λόγων, [[Mat.12.37|Mat.12:37]] διὰ τ. πίστεως, [[Rom.3.30|Rom.3:30]] with dative, [[Rom.3.24, 28|Rom.3:24, 28]], [[Tit.3.7|Tit.3:7]]; before ἐν, [[Act.13.39|Act.13:39]], [[Rom.3.4; 5.9|Rom.3:4 5:9]], [[1Co.4.4; 6.11|1Co.4:4 6:11]], [[Gal.2.17; 3.11; 5.4|Gal.2:17 3:11 5:4]], [[1Ti.3.16|1Ti.3:16]] (see Cremer, 193, 693; _DB_, ii, 826 ff.).†
(AS)

G1330.def:
**δι-έρχομαι **
[in LXX for אֵבֶר, הָלַךְ, בּוֹא, etc. ;]
1. **to go through, pass through**;
(a) **of things**: [[Mat.19.24|Mat.19:24]], [[Mrk.10.25|Mrk.10:25]], [[Luk.2.35|Luk.2:35]], al.;
(b) **of persons**: [[Luk.19.4|Luk.19:4]] with accusative loc., [[Luk.19.1|Luk.19:1]], [[Heb.4.14|Heb.4:14]], [[Act.12.10|Act.12:10]]; before διά, with genitive loc., [[Mat.12.43|Mat.12:43]], [[1Co.10.1|1Co.10:1]]; before εἰς, [[Mrk.4.35|Mrk.4:35]] ἕως, [[Luk.2.15|Luk.2:15]]
2. **to go about**: [[Luk.9.6|Luk.9:6]], [[Act.20.25|Act.20:25]]; of a report, **to spread, go abroad** (Thuc.), [[Luk.5.15|Luk.5:15]]
(AS)

G1365.def:
**διστάζω**
(δίς),
**to doubt, hesitate**: [[Mat.14.31; 28.17|Mat.14:31 28:17]].†
_SYN._: ἀπορέω, διαπορέω, διακρίνομαι, μετεωρίζομαι (see _DCG_, i, 491) (AS)

G1323.def:
**δίδραχμος**, -ον
(δίς, δραχμή),
**worth two drachmae**; τὸ δ. (sc. νόμισμα, _coin_),
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁקֶל ([[Gen.23.15|Gen.23:15]], a1.), also for כֶּסֶף: [[Gen.20.16|Gen.20:16]], [[Deu.22.29|Deu.22:29]] ;]
**a double drachma, nearly equal to the Jewish half-shekel, the amount of the Temple tax**: [[Mat.17.24|Mat.17:24]] (_DB_, iii, 428).†
(AS)

G1327.def:
**δι-έ-οδος**, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for תּוֹצָאָה, as [[Num.34.4|Num.34:4]]ff, and frequently in Jos;]
in π. of the conclusion of a trial (MM, _Exp._, xi); **a way out through, an outlet**; pl., δ. τῶν ὁδῶν, RV, the partings of the highways: [[Mat.22.9|Mat.22:9]]†
(AS)

G1362.def:
**διπλόος**
(poët., διπλός, whence corp. -ότερον), -όη, -όον (-οῦ, -ῆ, -οῦν) [in LXX for כָּפַל, מִשְׁנֶה, and cognates ;]
**twofold, double**: [[1Ti.5.17|1Ti.5:17]], [[Rev.18.6|Rev.18:6]]; διπλότιρον, **in twofold measure**: [[Mat.23.15|Mat.23:15]]†
(AS)

G1368.def:
**δι-υλίζω**
(δια, ὑλίζω, to strain) [in LXX: [[Amo.6.6|Amo.6:6]] * ;]
1. **to strain thoroughly** (Archytas; Am., l.with).
2. Later, **to strain out**: figuratively, [[Mat.23.24|Mat.23:24]]†
(AS)

G1371.def:
**διχοτομέω**, -ῶ
(διχοτόμος, δίχα, τέμνω), [in LXX: [[Exo.29.17|Exo.29:17]] (נָתַח pi.) ;]
**to cut in two, cut asunder**: perh. metaphorically of severe scourging (but see Meyer on Mt, l.with, and cf. [[1Ki.15.33|1Ki.15:33]], [[2Sa.12.31|2Ki.12:31]], [[Heb.11.37|Heb.11:37]]), [[Mat.24.51|Mat.24:51]], [[Luk.12.46|Luk.12:46]].†
(AS)

G1326.def:
**δι-εγείρω **
[in LXX: [[Jdt.1.4|Jdth.1:4]], [[Est.1.1|Est.1:1]], [[2Ma.7.21|2Ma.7:21]] [[2Mac.15.10|2Mac 15:10]], [[3Ma.5.15|3Ma.5:15]] * ;]
**to arouse completely, arouse as from rest or sleep**: [[Luk.8.24|Luk.8:24]] pass., [[Mrk.4.39|Mrk.4:39]], [[Luk.8.24|Luk.8:24]]; of the sea, [[Jhn.6.18|Jhn.6:18]] Metaphorical, of the mind: ἐν ὑπομνήσει, [[2Pe.1.13; 3.1|2Pe.1:13 3:1]].†
(AS)

G1367.def: **two thousand **, (Herdotus Historicus):—;_singular_ with collective nouns, δισχιλίη ἵππος 2000 horse, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G1334.def:
**δι-ηγέομαι**, -οῦμαι
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
**to set out in detail, recount, describe**: absol., [[Heb.11.32|Heb.11:32]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.8.33|Act.8:33]] with dative of person(s), before πῶς, [[Mrk.5.16|Mrk.5:16]], [[Act.9.27; 12.17|Act.9:27 12:17]]; ἅ εἶδον, [[Mrk.9.9|Mrk.9:9]] ὅσα ἐποίησε, -αν, [[Luk.8.39; 9.10|Luk.8:39 9:10]].†
(AS)

G1364.def:
**δίς **
_adv._,
**twice**: [[Mrk.14.30, 72|Mrk.14:30, 72]]; δ. τ. σαββάτου, [[Luk.18.12|Luk.18:12]] καὶ ἅπαξ κ. δ., [[Php.4.16|Php.4:16]], [[1Th.2.18|1Th.2:18]]; δ. ἀποθανόντα, [[Jude.12|Ju 12]] (see Mayor, _ICC_, in l); δ. μυριάδες, [[Rev.9.16|Rev.9:16]]†
(AS)

G1335.def:
**δι-ήγησις**, -εως, ἡ
(διηγέομαι), [in LXX: [[Jdg.7.15|Jdg.7:15]] מִסְפָּר [[Hab.2.6|Hab.2:6]] חִידָה), frequently in ([[Sir.6.35|Sir.6:35]], al.), [[2Ma.2.32|2Ma.2:32]] [[2Mac.6.17|2Mac 6:17]] ;]
**a narrative**: [[Luk.1.1|Luk.1:1]] (cf. Milligan, _NTD_, 130).†
(AS)

G1345.def:
**δικαίωμα**, -τος, τ
(δικαιόω), [in LXX most frequently for חֹק, in Ez, chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט, in Pss, τὰ δ., frequently for פִּקּוּד ;]
a concrete expression of righteousness, the expression and result of the act of δικαίωσις, "a declaration that a thing is δίκαιον, or that a person is δίκαιος," hence,
(a) **an ordinance**: δ. τ. θεοῦ, [[Rom.1.32|Rom.1:32]] τ. κυρίου, [[Luk.1.6|Luk.1:6]] τ. νόμου, [[Rom.2.26; 8.4|Rom.2:26 8:4]]; λατρείας, [[Heb.9.1|Heb.9:1]] σαρκός, [[Heb.9.10|Heb.9:10]]
(b) **a sentence**: _of acquittal_, [[Rom.5.16|Rom.5:16]] (also [[Rom.5.18|Rom.5:18]] _ICC_, in l), or _of condemnation_;
(with) **a righteous act**: [[Rom.5.18|Rom.5:18]] (RV), [[Rev.15.4; 19.8|Rev.15:4 19:8]] (on the usage of π., see MM, _Exp._, iii, xi).
† (AS)

G1378.def:
**δόγμα**, -τος, τό
(δοκέω), [in LXX chiefly for דָּת, טְעֵם ;]
1. **an opinion**.
2. **A public decree, ordinance**: of Roman rulers, [[Luk.2.1|Luk.2:1]], [[Act.17.7|Act.17:7]]; of the Jewish law, [[Eph.2.15|Eph.2:15]], [[Col.2.14|Col.2:14]]; of the Apostles, [[Act.16.4|Act.16:4]] (Cremer, 205).†
(AS)

G1301.def:
**δια-τηρέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for שָׁמַר, נָצַר, etc.; before ἀπό (for מִן), as in [[Psa.12.7|Psa.12:7]] (8) ;]
**to keep carefully**: [[Luk.2.51|Luk.2:51]] before ἐκ, [[Act.15.29|Act.15:29]]†
(AS)

G1314.def:
**δια-φυλάσσω **
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁמַר (as [[Psa.91.11|Psa.91:11]]) ;]
**to guard carefully** (M, _Pr._, 116), **defend**: with accusative, [[Luk.4.10|Luk.4:10]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G1353.def:
**δι-οδεύω**,
[in LXX chiefly for עבר ;]
1. **to travel through**: with accusative, [[Act.17.1|Act.17:1]]
2. **to travel along** ([[Bar.4.2|Bar.4:2]], [[1Ma.12.32-33|1Ma.12:32-33]]): [[Luk.8.1|Luk.8:1]].†
(AS)

G1316.def:
**δια-χωρίζω **
[in LXX: [[Gen.1.4|Gen.1:4]] ff (בָּדַל hi.), [[Gen.13.9|Gen.13:9]] ff. (פָּרַד ni.), etc. ;]
**to separate entirely**. Mid., **to separate oneself, depart**: before ἀπό [[Luk.9.33|Luk.9:33]]†
(AS)

G1311.def:
**δια-φθείρω **
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת hi. ;]
1. **to destroy utterly**: [[Luk.12.33|Luk.12:33]], [[Rev.11.18|Rev.11:18]]; pass., **to be destroyed, disabled**: [[Rev.8.9|Rev.8:9]], [[2Co.4.16|2Co.4:16]].
2. In moral sense, **to corrupt, deprave**: τ. γῆν, [[Rev.11.18|Rev.11:18]] pass., διεφθαρμένοι τ. νοῦν, [[1Ti.6.5|1Ti.6:5]]†
(AS)

G1381.def:
**δοκιμάζω**
(δόκιμος), [in LXX chiefly for בָּחַן ;]
1. primarily of metals ([[Pro.8.10; 17.3|Pro.8:10 17:3]], [[Sir.2.5|Sir.2:5]], [[Wis.3.6|Wis.3:6]]), **to test, try, prove** (in the hope and expectation that the test will prove successful, see reff. s. _Syn._): χρυσίον, [[1Pe.1.7|1Pe.1:7]] other things, [[Luk.12.56; 14.19|Luk.12:56 14:19]], [[2Co.8.8|2Co.8:8]], [[Gal.6.4|Gal.6:4]], [[1Th.2.4; 5.21|1Th.2:4 5:21]]; τὰ διαφέροντα, [[Rom.2.18|Rom.2:18]], [[Php.1.10|Php.1:10]] (R, mg., but see infr.); πνεύματα, [[1Jn.4.1|1Jn.4:1]] of men, [[1Ti.3.10|1Ti.3:10]] (pass.); ἑαυτόν, [[1Co.11.28|1Co.11:28]], [[2Co.13.5|2Co.13:5]]; before subst. clause, [[Rom.12.2|Rom.12:2]], [[1Co.3.13|1Co.3:13]], [[Eph.5.10|Eph.5:10]]
2. As the result of trial, **to approve, think fit**: [[Rom.1.28; 14.22|Rom.1:28 14:22]], [[1Co.16.3|1Co.16:3]], [[2Co.8.22|2Co.8:22]], [[1Th.2.4|1Th.2:4]] (δεδοκιμάσμεθα); τὰ διαφέροντα, [[Rom.2.18|Rom.2:18]], [[Php.1.10|Php.1:10]], R, txt. (but see supr.; cf. διαφέρω).†
(AS)

G1303.def:
**δια-τίθημι **
[in LXX chiefly for כָּרַת, frequently δ. διαθήκην (כָּרַת) ;]
**to place separately, arrange, dispose**. Mid, only in NT;
1. (a) in general, **to dispose of**; with dative of person(s), **to assign to one**, [[Luk.22.29|Luk.22:29]]
(b) **to dispose of by a will, make a testament** (in cl., δ. διαθήκην also in this sense): [[Heb.9.16-17|Heb.9:16-17]] (but cf. R, mg., and see: διαθήκη).
2. δ. διαθήκην, **to make a covenant** (Aristoph.): with dative of person(s), [[Heb.8.10|Heb.8:10]] (LXX); before πρ, with accusative of person(s), [[Act.3.25|Act.3:25]], [[Heb.10.16|Heb.10:16]]" (LXX) (cf. ἀντι-διατίθημι).†
(AS)

G1339.def:
**δι-ίσπημι**
(Rec. διΐσ), [in LXX: [[Ezk.5.1|Eze.5:1]] (חָלַק pi.), [[Pro.17.9|Pro.17:9]] (פָּרַד hi.), etc. ;]
**to set apart, separate**; of time (or space), **to make an interval, intervene**: διαστάσης ὥρας μιᾶς, [[Luk.22.59|Luk.22:59]] βραχὺ διαστήσαντες, [[Act.27.28|Act.27:28]] In pass., mid. and 2 aor., pf. and plpf. act., **to part, withdraw**: [[Luk.24.51|Luk.24:51]]†
(AS)

G1340.def:
**δι-ισχυρίζομαι** (T, Rec. διϊσ-), depon.;
1. **to lean upon**.
2. **to affirm confidently**: with ptcp., [[Luk.22.59|Luk.22:59]] with accusative and inf. (Bl., § 70, 3), [[Act.12.15|Act.12:15]]†
(AS)

G1318.def:
**διδακτός**, -ή, -όν
(διδάσκω), [in LXX: [[Isa.54.13|Isa.54:13]] (לִמּוּד), [[1Ma.4.7|1Ma.4:7]] * ;]
1. **that can be taught**.
2. **taught**; with genitive, of source of teaching (in cl., poët. only);
(a) **of persons**: δ. θεοῦ, [[Jhn.6.45|Jhn.6:45]] (LXX);
(b) of things, λόγοις δ. πνεύματος, [[1Co.2.13|1Co.2:13]]†
(AS)

G1324.def:
**Δίδυμος**, -ου, ὁ
(prop. name from δίδυμος, -η, -ον, _double_, sc. παῖς, _twin_)
**Didymus**, surname of the apostle Thomas: [[Jhn.11.16; 20.24; 21.2|Jhn.11:16 20:24 21:2]].†
(AS)

G1312.def:
**δια-φθορὰ**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(διαφθείρω), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת, and cogn. forms ;]
1. **destruction**.
2. **corruption** (physical or moral): of the grave, [[Act.2.27|Act.2:27]] (LXX), [[Act.2.31; 13.34-37|Act.2:31 13:34-37]].†
(AS)

G1315.def:
**δια-χειρίζω**
(χείρ),
**to have in hand, conduct, manage**. Mid.
(a) = act.;
(b) in late writers (Polyb., FlJ, al.), **to lay hands on, kill**: with accusative, [[Act.5.30; 26.21|Act.5:30 26:21]].†
(AS)

G1348.def:
**δικαστής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(δικάζω), [in LXX for שָׁפַט ;]
**a judge**: [[Act.7.27, 35|Act.7:27, 35]]" (LXX) .†
_SYN._: κριτής, WH. "gives prominence to the mental process" (Thayer). δ. is the forensic term. In Attic law, the δικασταί were jurors, with a κριτής as presiding officer (LS, see word; Enc. Brit. 11, xii, 504 f.) (AS)

G1393.def:
**Δορκάς**, -άδος, ἡ
(δορκάς, a gazelle),
Dorcas, also called Ταβειθά, which see: [[Act.9.36, 39|Act.9:36, 39]].†
(AS)

G1356.def:
**διοπετής** (written also διϊπ-), -ές
(δῖος, πίπτω, see Page on Ac, l.with; _DB_, i, 605, n., _ext._, 112a; Field, _Notes_, 130 f.),
**fallen from heaven** (R, mg.): τὸ δ. (sc. ἄγαλμα, **statue**, **image**), [[Act.19.35|Act.19:35]]†
(AS)

G1357.def:
**διόρθωσις**, -εως, ἡ (see supr.),
1. **a making straight**.
2. **a reforming**, **reformation** (used in late writers of laws, etc.): [[Heb.9.10|Heb.9:10]] (Cremer, 807).†
**διόρθωμα**, -τος, τό
(διορθόω, _to make straight, set right_),
**a correction, reform**: [[Act.24.3|Act.24:3]]†
**διόρθωσις**, -εως, ἡ (see supr.),
1. **a making straight**.
2. **a reforming**, **reformation** (used in late writers of laws, etc.): [[Heb.9.10|Heb.9:10]] (Cremer, 807).†
(AS)

G1333.def:
**διετία**, -ας, ἡ
(διετής), [in LXX (Græc. Ven.): [[Gen.41.1; 45.5|Gen.41:1 45:5]] * ;]
**the space of two years**: [[Act.24.27; 28.30|Act.24:27 28:30]].†
(AS)

G1300.def:
**δια-τελέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Deu.9.7|Deu.9:7]] (הָיָה), [[Jer.20.7, 18|Jer.20:7, 18]] (כָּלָה), [[Est.8.13|Est.8:13]], [[2Ma.5.27|2Ma.5:27]] * ;]
prop. trans., **to accomplish**; used with ellipse of obj. as intrans. (Bl., § 81, 1), and joined to participles (in Ac, Lc., to adj.; see Bl., § 73, 4) with adverbial sense (= continuously), **to continue**: [[Act.27.33|Act.27:33]]†
(AS)

G1337.def:
**διθάλασσος**, -ον
(δις, θύλασσα);
1. **divided into two seas** (as the Euxine, Strab., ii, 522).
2. **dividing the sea**: τόπον δ., a tongue of land, or **reef, running out into the sea**: [[Act.27.41|Act.27:41]]†
(AS)

G1349.def:
**δίκη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for נָקָם, רִיב, etc. ;]
1. **custom**.
2. **right**.
3. **a judicial hearing**; hence its result, **the execution of a sentence, punishment**: δ. τίνειν, [[2Th.1.9|2Th.1:9]] δ. υπεχειν, [[Jude.7|Ju 7]].
4. Personified (cf. Lat. Justitia), **justice, vengeance**: [[Act.28.4|Act.28:4]]†
(AS)

G1359.def:
**Διόσ-κουροι**, -ων, οἱ
(Ion. and κοινή form of Att..., Διόσκοροι; Διός, genitive of Ζεύς + κόρος, a son),
**the Dioscuri** (Castor and Pollux), twin sons of Zeus and Leda (RV, The Twin Brothers): [[Act.28.11|Act.28:11]]†
(AS)

G1341.def:
**δικαιοκρισία**, -ας, ἡ
**righteous judgment**: [[Rom.2.5|Rom.2:5]] (cf. τ. δικαίας κρίσεως, [[2Th.1.5|2Th.1:5]] τὴν δ. κ., [[Jhn.7.24|Jhn.7:24]] For use in π., see Deiss., _LAE_, 89 f.).†
(AS)

G1387.def:
**δολιόω**
(δόλιος), [in LXX: [[Num.25.18|Num.25:18]], [[Psa.105.25|Psa.105:25]] (נָכַל), [[Psa.5.6|Psa.5:6]] (חָלַק hi.) * ;]
**to deceive**: ἐδολιοῦσαν (-σαν, frequently in κοινή Gk. for imperfect 3rd of person(s) pl.), [[Rom.3.13|Rom.3:13]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G1347.def:
**δικαίωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(δικαιόω), [in LXX for מִשְׁפָּט, [[Lev.24.22|Lev.24:22]] * ;]
**the act of pronouncing righteous, justification, acquittal**: [[Rom.4.25; 5.18|Rom.4:25 5:18]] (Cremer, 199).†
(AS)

G1382.def:
**δοκιμή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(δόκιμος), [in Sm.: [[Psa.68.31|Psa.68:31]] * ;]
1. the process of trial, **proving, test**: [[2Co.8.2; 9.13|2Co.8:2 9:13]]
2. The result of trial, **approval, approvedness, proof**: [[Rom.5.4|Rom.5:4]], [[2Co.2.9; 13.3|2Co.2:9 13:3]], [[Php.2.22|Php.2:22]] (Cremer, 212, 701).†
(AS)

G1397.def:
**δουλεία** (T, -λία), -ας, ἡ
(δουλεύω), [in LXX, as [[Exo.13.3|Exo.13:3]], for עֶבֶד and cognates ;]
**slavery, bondage**: [[Rom.8.15, 21|Rom.8:15, 21]] [[Gal.4.24; 5.1|Gal.4:24 5:1]], [[Heb.2.15|Heb.2:15]].†
(AS)

G1313.def:
**διά-φορος**, -ον
(διαφέρω), [in LXX for שְׁנָא ([[Dan.7.7, 19|Dan.7:7, 19]]); also as in Polyb., iv, 188, al., Τὸ δ., τὰ δ., **money**: [[Sir.27.1; 42.5|Sir.27:1 42:5]], [[2Ma.3.6|2Ma.3:6]] ;]
1. **different**: [[Rom.12.6|Rom.12:6]], [[Heb.9.10|Heb.9:10]].
2. **excellent**: compar., -ώτερος, [[Heb.1.4; 8.6|Heb.1:4 8:6]].†
(AS)

G1384.def:
**δοκίμιος**, -α, -ον
(δοκιμή), [in LXX: ἀργύριον δ. (עֲלִיל), [[Psa.12.6|Psa.12:6]] and as seel. for δόκιμος (B), ἀργυρίου δ. (זָקַק pual.), [[1Ch.29.4|1Ch.29:4]] (Bab); εἰ δ .ίστιν (יְקָר), [[Zec.11.13|Zec.11:13]] א with a vid, Q *)* ;]
= δόκιμος,
**tested, approved**: τὸ δ. ὑμῶν τ. πίστεως, _that which is approved in your faith_, [[1Pe.1.7|1Pe.1:7]] (where Hort suggests the seel. δόκιμος, found in some cursives), [[Jas.1.3|Jas.1:3]] (but see Mayor, in l For full discussion of this word, not hitherto found in a Gk. Lexicon, and for exx. of its use in π., see Deiss. (to whom is due the credit of its discovery), BS, 259 ff.; MM, _Exp._, xi; cf. also Milligan, _NTD_, 76).†
**δόκιμος**, -ον
(δέκομαι = δέχομαι) [in LXX for זָקַק pual., etc. ;]
primarily of metals, **tested, accepted, approved**: of persons, [[Rom.14.18; 16.10|Rom.14:18 16:10]], [[1Co.11.19|1Co.11:19]], [[2Co.10.18; 13.7|2Co.10:18 13:7]], [[2Ti.2.15|2Ti.2:15]], [[Jas.1.12|Jas.1:12]] (Cremer, 212, 697).†
(AS)

G1370.def:
**διχοστασία**, -ας, ἡ
(διχοστατέω, _to stand apart_), [in LXX: [[1Ma.3.29|1Ma.3:29]] * ;]
**standing apart, dissension**: [[Rom.16.17|Rom.16:17]], [[Gal.5.20|Gal.5:20]].†
(AS)

G1355.def:
**διό-περ ** _conjunct._ (διό, which see, strengthened by πέρ),
[in LXX: [[Jdt.8.17|Jdth.8:17]] [[Jdt.8.1-36;|Jdt.8.1-36]] [[2Ma.5.1-27|2Ma.5:1-27]] * ;]
**for which very reason**: [[1Co.8.13; 10.14|1Co.8:13 10:14]].†
(AS)

G1396.def:
**δουλαγωγέω**, -ῶ
(δοῦλος, ἄγω),
**to make a slave, bring into bondage**: [[1Co.9.27|1Co.9:27]] (Cremer, 703).†
(AS)

G1389.def:
**δολόω**, -ῶ
(δόλος) [in LXX: [[Psa.15.3|Psa.15:3]] (רָגַל), [[Psa.36.2|Psa.36:2]] (חָלַק hi.) * ;]
1. **to ensnare**.
2. As of wine, **to adulterate, corrupt**: τ. λόγον τ. θεοῦ, [[2Co.4.2|2Co.4:2]]†
_SYN._: καπηλεύω which see (AS)

G1386.def:
**δόλιος**, -α, -ον
(δόλος), [in LXX—chiefly in Pss, Pr, Sir—for etc. ;]
**deceitful**: [[2Co.11.13|2Co.11:13]]†
(AS)

G1373.def:
**δίψος**, -εος (-ους), τό
(late form of δίψα), [in LXX chiefly for and cognates ;]
**thirst**: [[2Co.11.27|2Co.11:27]]†
(AS)

G1394.def:
**δόσις**, -εως, ἡ
(δίδωμι) [in LXX for חֹק ([[Gen.47.22|Gen.47:22]]), ([[Pro.21.14; 25.14|Pro.21:14 25:14]]), frequently in Sir. ;]
1. **properly, the act of giving**: [[Php.4.15|Php.4:15]]
2. **Objectively, a gift**: [[Jas.1.17|Jas.1:17]]†
_SYN._: see: δόμα (AS)

G1379.def:
**δογματίζω **
[in LXX: [[Est.3.9|Est.3:9]] (כָּתַב ni.), Dan LXX 2:13, 15 (דָּת), I [[Est.6.34|Est.6:34]], [[2Ma.10.3|2Ma.10:3]] [[2Mac.15.36|2Mac 15:36]], [[3Ma.4.11|3Ma.4:11]] * ;]
**to decree**. Mid., **to subject oneself to an ordinance**: [[Col.2.20|Col.2:20]]†
(AS)

G1351.def:
**διλογος**, -ον
(δίς, λέγω),
1. in sense of διλογεῖν, -ία (Xen.), **given to repetition**.
2. In NT, prob. (cf. δίγλωσσος, [[Pro.11.13|Pro.11:13]], [[Sir.5.9|Sir.5:9]]) **double-tongued**: [[1Ti.3.8|1Ti.3:8]]†
(AS)

G1305.def:
**δια-τροφή**, ῆς, ἡ
(διατρέφω, _to support, sustain_), [in LXX: [[1Ma.6.49|1Ma.6:49]] * ;]
**food, nourishment**: [[1Ti.6.8|1Ti.6:8]]†
(AS)

G1366.def:
**δίστομος**, -ον
(δίς, στόμα), [in LXX: [[Jdg.3.16|Jdg.3:16]], [[Psa.149.6|Psa.149:6]], [[Pro.5.4|Pro.5:4]] (פֶּה), [[Sir.21.3|Sir.21:3]] * ;]
1. of rivers and roads, **double-mouthed, double branching**.
2. Of swords (Eur.; LXX, ll with), **two-edged**: [[Heb.4.12|Heb.4:12]], [[Rev.1.16; 2.12|Rev.1:16 2:12]].†
(AS)

G1338.def:
**δι-ικνέομαι** (Rec. διϊκ-), **-οῦμαι**,
[in LXX for בָּרַח hi., [[Exo.26.28|Exo.26:28]] * ;]
**to go through, penetrate**: [[Heb.4.12|Heb.4:12]]†
(AS)

G1336.def:
**δι-ηνεκής**, -ές
(διήνεγκα, aorist of διαφέρω) [in Sm.: [[Psa.48.15; 89.30|Psa.48:15, 89:30]] ;]
**unbroken, continuous**: adverbially, εἰς τὸ δ., continually (for exx., see Deiss., BS, 251), [[Heb.7.3; 10.1, 12; 10.14|Heb.7:3 10:1, 12 10:14]]†
(AS)

G1383.def:
**δοκίμιον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX: [[Pro.17.3; 27.21|Pro.17:3 27:21]] (מִצְרֵף) * ;]
usually regarded as a variant form of δοκιμεῖον, **a test**, and so perh. [[Jas.1.3|Jas.1:3]] (see Mayor, in l), but see next word (cf. Cremer, 212, 702).†
(AS)

G1361.def:
**Διοτρέφης** (Rec. -τρεψής), -ες
(Διός, genitive of Ζεύς + τρέφω: _cherished by Zeus_),
as proper name, **Diotrephes**: [[3Jn.9|III Jn 9]].†
(AS)
